independence: Reviewer authored no evaluated implementation, scientific estimator, manuscript, figure source or conclusion. Only QA scripts, derivative QA raster images, contact sheets and this review were written. Local team review, not external peer review or independent numerical/model replication.
scope: Actual final production R18 PDF, complete 111 PNG/SVG figure pairs, main and gallery HTML static readability/link/assets; no new experiment, reserve-outcome access, model/API call, training or numerical replay.

actual_visual_coverage.method: Opened every actual PNG through 13 overview sheets. Rasterized every actual SVG locally with bundled sharp 0.35.5/librsvg 2.63.2, first under default font resolution then under QA-only fontconfig pointing at exact existing Matplotlib DejaVu fonts; opened all 13 sheets of each rendering. Opened the listed key original PNGs individually and every one of 9 Poppler-rendered PDF pages at 150 dpi. Some UI image presentations resize images; all underlying QA rasters remain available.

PDF_layout.detail: All 9 pages inspected: 5 portrait narrative pages and 4 landscape paper-figure pages. Body text, full-width result table, code equations, section/page transitions, references, headers/footers, page numbers and all four figure captions are readable with no visible missing glyph, clipping, overlapping body text or figure/caption collision. Page 6 shows all 56 forest rows and full M1-M8 model legend in the caption.

complete_figure_layout.detail: All 111 PNGs and all 111 SVGs inspected in overview sheets. Dataset/split titles, signs, scales, support denominators, dense heatmap printed labels, legends and uncertainty scope are consistent and generally readable at original-file zoom. A systematic pair-triptych bottom annotation collision remains (finding V1). Full gallery footers are dense and require opening/zooming original images; four large-font paper figures solve paper-scale readability.

scope_and_missingness.detail: Historical released judge-ACK scope, pre-outcome metadata quarantine, cue-kind H2 contexts, exploratory reused-question discovery and held-out confirmation limitations remain visible. All 28 GPQA confirmation comparisons remain unsupported/gray N/A, while source table keeps descriptive ranges. Version point components can be zero but version intervals remain N/A; no zero-interval imputation, raw-gap CIs, causal version effect, corrected true ranking, latent-faithfulness finding or current frontier-model evaluation is asserted. Paper examples disclose largest-absolute eligible selection as descriptive, with raw-gap points separated from total-shift CIs. Binary design diagram is hypothetical/conditional and includes own-baseline cued cells.

HTML_static.detail: Parsed both final HTML documents, checked all 352 local href/src references and 115 images (all with alt labels), no missing or escaping local target, no scripts or remote render assets. Nine external citation links were classified but not fetched. Read full text/CSS: responsive width/padding, readable line spacing, horizontal table wrapper, wrapped code/links and image height:auto are present. Main HTML has 4 figure/caption sections and a 5-column/3-row scientific table. Browser-rendered responsive/print behavior was not tested.

blocking_findings.scope: All 56 model-pair triptychs in both PNG and SVG formats
blocking_findings.description: The middle panel bottom MMLU Version shift: N/A annotation falls below the axis and overlaps x-axis tick labels. Direct full-size visual collision was confirmed in discovery_pair_m01_m02, confirmation_pair_m01_m05 and confirmation_pair_m06_m08. Direct actual-SVG coordinate measurement found the bottom annotation outside the middle axes in all 56 pair figures. For confirmation_pair_m06_m08, text baseline y=342.152529 pt exceeds axis bottom y=330.843270 pt.
blocking_findings.cause: In render_pairs, annotation text at category i+0.2 does not extend Matplotlib automatic y limits, and the unavailable version interval contributes no data point to autoscaling.
blocking_findings.requested_change: Apply explicit categorical y limits with padding to the pair-triptych panels, retain the same data/interval values and N/A labels, regenerate in a new preserved attempt and recheck all pair layouts. Explicit padding is also advisable in all-N/A interval panels so end labels sit inside the axes.

nonblocking_findings.detail: SVG retains editable text rather than embedding DejaVu. Default local librsvg lacked the specified family and substituted monospace, clipping one paper-support panel title. Using the exact declared DejaVu font resolves this without modifying SVG bytes. Readers should use PNG/PDF for font-independent viewing or install the declared font; this is a viewer/font dependency, not changed scientific data.

Poppler emitted No display font for Symbol and ArialUnicode warnings while rendering. No missing or malformed glyph was seen on any actual page; the delivered ASCII narrative and embedded Vera text render legibly.

limitations: No independent numerical replication, model rerun, CSV value verification or new scientific validity assessment performed by this reviewer; /root/reset_critic owns that separate review.

No browser-rendered HTML screenshots: CUA denied a file:/// SVG URL because its browser URL policy allows only http/https and explicitly prohibited workarounds. Browser use stopped immediately, no local server/alternate browser route was used. Safer local SVG rasterization and static HTML/CSS/filesystem inspection were used instead.

Visual overview inspection is broad layout coverage, not proof that every numeric value or every font renderer is correct. Key individual files and all final PDF pages were checked for detailed legibility.
SVG rendering depends on the specified available DejaVu family; default-font diagnostic renders are preserved separately from exact-font final QA renders.
